# TarkovTracker

TarkovTracker is a Nuxt 4 static single-page app for planning Escape from Tarkov tasks and maps.
Progress is stored locally in the browser.

The viewer reads matching schema-v1 `tasks`, `state`, and `scores` JSON documents from
`/quest-data` or a configured static exporter base. It has no application API or account system.

## Primary page

- [Tasks](https://tarkovtracker.org/tasks): Task planning and interactive maps.
